To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a new loss function for pairwise classification that can be used to optimize ranking algorithms, and show that it can be used to improve the performance of ranking algorithms for information retrieval.

we propose to use ordered weighted aggregation operators in the pairwise classification approach for ranking and that this approach has better generalization properties and is more effective than the standard pairwise classification approach for information retrieval.
we propose a new class of loss functions, based on OWA, for ranking with pairwise classification.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions. How can we extend the pairwise ranking approach by using OWA aggregation of classification losses?

the following aspects: (1) the definition of a new class of losses for pairwise classification based on ordered weighted averages; (2) the analysis of the properties of these losses; (3) their application to the task of information retrieval; (4) an empirical evaluation.

the following contributions: (i) We propose to optimize OWA aggregates of classification losses for ranking, and show that the resulting optimization problem can be solved with the SVM for inter-dependent output spaces.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art methods for information retrieval on the Letor dataset.

the proposed OWA aggregation approach for ranking with pairwise classification losses provides a flexible way to focus on different parts of the ranked list, while maintaining a good generalization performance.
the proposed method is an effective approach to the problem of ranking documents in the context of information retrieval.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose to optimize a class of ranking losses based on ordered weighted average of classification losses.
we propose a novel approach to learn to rank, which is a generalization of pairwise ranking and which is based on ordered weighted averages.

we introduce OWA aggregation operators to ranking and propose a novel loss function based on OWA aggregation operators that can be applied to any classification loss and can be optimized using the same techniques as for the pairwise classification loss.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can optimize a much larger class of ranking losses than previously considered, and we can do it with a very simple modification of the SVM algorithm for interdependent output space.
we show that the OWA aggregation operator can be used in a variety of classification problems to focus on different parts of the ranking.
the pairwise loss is a special case of the OWA aggregation of the pairwise classification loss.
